Cancer and radiation therapy Valvular heart disease is commonly associated with cancer and repre- sents a well-known long-term side effect of intensive radiation ther- apy176 for treatment of Hodgkin or non-Hodgkin lymphoma, breast cancer, and other thoracic malignancies.177 Clinically significant VHD most commonly appears decades after radiotherapy. The incidence of radiation-induced VHD is increasing owing to longer survival of pa- tients with cancer. Risk factors are summarized in Supplementary data online, Table S1.
